ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture shows several developmental stages. A is an oval egg-like object; D is a clearly segmented, worm-like larva; C looks like a pupal stage; B and E are adults, with oval bodies, an appearance like hard wing cases, and spots, overall looking very much like beetles. Reasoning: These stages match the life cycle of insects with complete metamorphosis: egg → larva → pupa → adult. The adult form has the characteristics of beetles, so this picture represents the life cycle of a beetle.
